subject: Proposal: 18-month commit acceleration + dynamic rate banding (Veloce Labs)
messages:
From: Alex Torres <alex.torres@velocelabs.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@velocelabs.ai
Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2026 16:12:00 -0400
Subject: Hosted API - capacity request & term proposal

Hi Marissa,

Quick note from the usage side: we hit a sustained higher baseline in May and expect this to continue as we ramp a new feature in Q3. Currently we’re on a 6M token/month hosted commit; we’d like to move to a predictable 18M token/month profile and are open to an 18-month term in exchange for a more favorable unit rate and a guaranteed soft burst window.

Key asks:
- Target monthly commit: 18M tokens/month (start 2026-07-01)
- Preferred term: 18 months (alignment with our fiscal cadence)
- Rate profile: tiered bands with a lower per-token rate inside commit, a moderate overage band, and a short high-burst allowance for launches
- Ops: 15-minute paging for Sev A incidents, and a documented fallback model if we exceed burst for >30m

Can you put together an addendum + pricing grid? We’ll need an MSA amendment and a PO route once pricing is agreed.

Thanks,
Alex
Alex Torres
Head of Product
Veloce Labs

Marissa — pricing sketch below (high level)

Proposed commercial model (sketch):
- Committed: 18M tokens / month at $0.0038 per token (applies to tokens consumed inside the commit)
- Overage band: next 12M tokens at $0.0050/token (soft overage up to 2x commit before burst kicks in)
- Burst allowance: up to 25% additional tokens for 4x short windows per quarter at $0.0075/token (automated throttles and prefail notifications)
- One-time onboarding credit: $5k applied to first invoice if 18-month term signed by 2026-06-25
- SLA add-on: 99.9% availability commitment for hosted route at this commit level; 15-min pager for Sev A included in enterprise support pack

Ops note (Evelyn): if Veloce expects sustained peaks above 3x baseline for >48 hours, recommend migrating to a Dedicated reservation; we should include a clause that allows for a capacity review after the first 90 days and optional Dedicated conversion pricing.

Rishi — I’ve kept the wording concise; confirm legal language for the burst/fallback clause (automated throttle / prioritized best-effort fallback). If approved, I’ll hand to Marissa to bundle into the addendum.

– Karthik
